newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barge rates - Prices mostly steady on call.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barge rates - Prices mostly steady on call.

text.p: U.S. barge rates were quoted at mostly steady to lower levels on Monday on the St. Louis Merchants Exchange call session, the Exchange said. No barges traded verus none on Friday.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, Clinton and South, this week, bid 170 percent of tariff, no offer.
- Two barges, Mid-Mississippi River, LaGrange and South, this week, bid 180 percent, no offer.
- Five barges, Scattered and Even, Mid-Mississippi, 30 day open, bid 165 percent, down 2-1/2 percentage points, no offer.
- Eight barges, two each week April, mid-Mississippi, bid at 145 percent, down five percentage points, similar, no offer.
